# NVDA Technical Analysis Report (as of 2026-11-11)

## 1. Summary

NVDA is in a sharp, high-volume downtrend. The verified close on 2026-11-11 is **173.73**. That is about 27.4% below the 2026-10-06 close of 239.24, the highest close in the last 30 sessions.

- **Trend:** Price is below the 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA and VWMA. MACD is negative and below its signal line.
- **Momentum:** RSI is 28.74, which is oversold. It has been sub-30 on four of the last five sessions.
- **Volatility:** ATR is 8.70, up from 5.59 on 2026-10-12. Price is hugging the lower Bollinger Band.
- **Latest session:** 2026-11-11 closed up 2.87% from 168.89, with a higher high and higher low than 2026-11-10. This is a tentative bounce, not a confirmed reversal.

The tools give no news or fundamental data, so I can't say what caused the selloff.

## 2. Data integrity

The verified snapshot and the individual indicator calls agree for 2026-11-11. This covers the 10 EMA (188.57), 50 SMA (217.10), 200 SMA (204.19), RSI (28.74), lower band (170.64), MACD (-12.12) and ATR (8.70). **I found no discrepancies.**

Two caveats:
- The Bollinger middle and upper bands, MACD signal and MACD histogram come from the snapshot only (203.80, 236.97, -8.03, -4.09). I did not call them separately and have no history for them.
- The 2026-11-11 volume of 266,639,830 is a non-round figure. If the session was not complete when pulled, treat it as possibly partial and don't compare it directly with prior full days.

## 3. Price action and volume

The decline came in stages:

| 2026-10-30 | 204.64 | Down from 213.66 the prior day. Volume 168.4M, up from 77.6M. |

- The 462.7M volume on 2026-11-09 is the highest in that window. The next highest are 298.9M on 2026-08-27 and 289.4M on 2026-05-29.
- Price has broken below the lows of the roughly 190–230 range that held from June through October. Examples are the 2026-06-29 low of 189.59 and the 2026-07-29 low and close of 189.80.
- Heavy volume on the way down shows aggressive selling. It can also mark capitulation, but price data alone can't confirm that.

## 4. Trend indicators

**Moving averages (2026-11-11)**

| Indicator | Value | Close vs. level |
|---|---|---|
| 10 EMA | 188.57 | 14.84 below |
| VWMA | 189.15 | 15.42 below |
| 200 SMA | 204.19 | 30.46 below |
| 50 SMA | 217.10 | 43.37 below |

- **10 EMA:** It fell from 230.71 on 2026-10-12 to 188.57. That is a steady, accelerating decline, with no short-term trend turn yet.
- **50 SMA:** It is rolling over. It peaked at 223.09 on 2026-10-14 and is now 217.10, falling every day since 2026-10-14.
- **200 SMA:** It is flattening. It peaked at 204.39 on 2026-11-06 and has slipped to 204.19.
- **50/200 relationship:** The 50 SMA is still above the 200 SMA (217.10 vs. 204.19), so there is no death cross today. The gap has narrowed from about 20.9 on 2026-10-14 (223.09 vs. 202.37). If price stays well below both averages, the 50 SMA will keep falling toward the 200 SMA. The data doesn't say when or whether a cross happens.
- **VWMA vs. 10 EMA:** The VWMA is about 0.6 above the 10 EMA, so volume-weighted prices are not lower than simple trend prices. Heavy-volume days are not skewing the average dramatically versus the EMA. Both sit at about 189, which forms an **overhead resistance cluster**. In the daily bars, 2026-11-06 traded 185.22–194.90.

## 5. Momentum

- **MACD:** It crossed below zero between 2026-10-15 (+0.94) and 2026-10-16 (-0.15). It is now -12.12 against a signal of -8.03, a histogram of -4.09. That is a bearish configuration with no crossover in sight.
- **Pace of decline:** The daily change in MACD is slowing: -1.72 from 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-09 (-8.23 to -9.57 is -1.34 and -9.57 to -11.29 is -1.72), then -0.83 on 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-11. The selloff is losing some speed, but MACD is still falling.
- **RSI:** Its path from 2026-11-04 is 34.54, 25.40, 30.77, 27.41, 23.95, 28.74.
  - It is oversold at 28.74.
  - **Oversold didn't mark a bottom here.** The first sub-30 reading on 2026-11-05 (close 181.60) was followed by a lower close of 168.89 on 2026-11-10.
  - **There is no bullish divergence yet.** The 2026-11-10 RSI low (23.95) is lower than the 2026-11-05 low (25.40), so momentum made a lower low along with price.
  - RSI was above 30 on every day from 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-04.

## 6. Volatility and Bollinger Bands

- The lower band is 170.64, the middle band is 203.80 and the upper band is 236.97. The bands are very wide (about 66.3 points), which reflects the recent expansion in volatility.
- **Closes below the lower band:** 2026-11-05 (181.60 vs. 191.69), 2026-11-06 (186.64 vs. 187.73), 2026-11-09 (178.67 vs. 182.24) and 2026-11-10 (168.89 vs. 175.36).
- **2026-11-11:** The close of 173.73 is back above the lower band (170.64) by 3.09. This is the first close inside the band since 2026-11-04. The lower band is itself falling, from 217.82 on 2026-10-14 to 170.64.
- Prices can ride the lower band in a strong downtrend, so a band touch is not a buy signal by itself.
- **ATR:** It is 8.70, about 56% above the 5.59 on 2026-10-12. The daily ranges were 9.68 on 2026-11-09, 8.80 on 2026-11-10 and 6.77 on 2026-11-11.
- **Illustrative stop distances:** 1.5x ATR is about 13.0 points and 2x ATR is about 17.4. These are arithmetic examples only.

## 8. Scenarios for the trading decision

**Bearish continuation.** The trend structure supports this.
- Evidence: price is below every average, MACD is negative with a widening gap to its signal, and RSI hasn't diverged.
- What would confirm it: a close back below the 2026-11-10 low of 165.89, or renewed closes below the lower band.
- Sizing implication: with ATR at 8.70, expect wide daily swings.

**Oversold bounce or relief rally.** This is plausible but unconfirmed.
- Evidence: RSI is under 30, the close is back inside the band, and 2026-11-11 made a higher high and higher low.
- What to watch: a hold above 170.64 and 165.89, and follow-through toward 177.54–181.60.
- Resistance: the 188.6–189.2 average cluster and the broken 189.6–189.8 range lows are the first major overhead areas.
- Rallies into the 10 EMA, VWMA or 50 SMA would still be below a falling trend.

**What would shift the picture toward a base:**
- RSI higher while price holds the 165.89 low (bullish divergence).
- MACD turning up and narrowing toward its signal.
- Price reclaiming the 10 EMA and VWMA (~189) on stable volume.

No tool output supports a long-term thesis change either way, and the cause of the drop is unknown from these tools. Whoever decides the trade should weigh this against fundamental and news context.
